name: Kyuuketsuki Elizaveta ~ Taikutsu na Maou ni Moteasobareru Chiisana Tsubomi to Hanabira
original_name: 吸血姫エリザヴェータ～退屈な魔王に弄ばれる小さな蕾と花弁
source:
"So weary. So dull."
The words plucked themselves from my crooked mouth.
Eternity carried on, as it does, day after endless day.
I was ruler of all, and yet a prisoner.

Elizabeta was my salvation from boredom.
This peon, this perky maidservant... a perfect antidote to my malaise.
What was this once-human vampire slave doing so close to my greatness!?
I am a tolerant lord... but this was unacceptable. My patience was at its end.
Thank you Elizabeta. You are the outlet for this Devil King's wrath. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092221.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“好疲惫。真无聊。”这句话从我扭曲的嘴里自行吐出。永恒一如既往地延续着，日复一日，没完没了。我统治着一切，却也是一个囚徒。

伊丽莎白是我摆脱无聊的救赎。这个卑微的家伙，这个活泼的女仆……正是治愈我倦怠的完美良药。这个曾经是人类的吸血鬼奴隶，怎么会离我的伟大如此之近！？

我是一位宽容的领主……但这不可接受。我的耐心已经到了尽头。

谢谢你，伊丽莎白。你就是魔王发泄怒火的出口。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092221.html]DLsite English[/url]]
